canada.title: Risk of landslides in Cariboo following Pear Lake wildfire: report
canada.summary: There is a high risk of landslides, floods and debris flow in parts of the Cariboo region after a massive wildfire earlier this year, according to a preliminary report released by B.C.’s Ministry of Forests.

canada.title: Impacts from B.C. drenching mount as water levels rise
canada.summary: The impacts of the drenching on B.C.'s south coast have been increasing as rain triggers evacuation orders and alerts, flood warnings and the shutdown of a water treatment plant.

canada.title: 'Diluted' and 'muddled': Plan to split Lethbridge into 1 urban, 3 hybrid ridings gets blowback
canada.summary: The Independent Advisory Panel on Electoral Boundaries recommended the expansion of electoral divisions to 91 from 87 for the province's next general election. Under the changes, Lethbridge would have one riding solely made up of roughly 60,000 city residents, as well as three hybrid ridings.

canada.title: College, municipality partner on project looking at history of Fort McMurray neighbourhood
canada.summary: A history project led by the Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo and Keyano College is preserving fading memories of the neighbourhood of Waterways, which lost 90 per cent of its buildings in the 2016 Horse River Wildfire.

canada.title: House fire in Ajax 'appears suspicious': Durham police
canada.summary: A house fire in Ajax on Thursday morning is being looked at as a suspicious incident, according to Durham police.

canada.title: Yukon MLA tables ranked-choice voting bill, even with a slim chance it becomes law
canada.summary: Yukon voters supported changing the territory's electoral system in a plebiscite last fall. The governing Yukon Party, however, continues to say no.

canada.title: Coroner’s inquest set to begin for Jamal Francique, shot in head by police
canada.summary: Jamal Francique died in hospital on Jan. 9, 2020, two days after police shot him during a botched arrest in Mississauga, Ont. He was 28.

canada.title: Houston’s hefty levy on EVs and plug-in hybrids could be costly for human health and the climate
canada.summary: EVs don’t feed as much into road tax budgets, but they actually save public health budget an even greater amount, or the same amount.

canada.title: Large data centres unlikely to be built in Saskatoon, council hears
canada.summary: Saskatoon Coun. Scott Ford, who wanted to explore restrictions on large data centres, suggests he's unlikely to support spending money to create new rules since such facilities are being built outside of cities.

canada.title: New Weyburn Humane Society cat room named for highway shooting victim
canada.summary: The new cat playroom at the Weyburn Humane Society is a place for the community to remember Tanya Myers, 44, who was fatally shot while in a moving vehicle on Highway 39, driving toward Weyburn, Sask., in September 2025.

canada.title: Lockdowns are happening at Whitehorse jail for wrong reasons, advocates say
canada.summary: Inmates at Whitehorse Correctional Centre faced unscheduled lockdowns almost every second day this year, adding up to hundreds of additional hours confined to their cells. Lawyers say that affects mental health, access to programming and court proceedings.

canada.title: Survivor of intimate partner violence a 'profile in courage,' says federal justice minister
canada.summary: Justice Minister Sean Fraser said he wants survivors such as Jessie Vandewiel to know they're "not alone." Vandewiel recently asked a judge to remove the publication ban on her identity so she could speak out about her experiences.

canada.title: Construction breaks ground for permanent dikes to mitigate flooding in First Nation in Manitoba's Interlake
canada.summary: Fisher River is breaking ground this fall, building permanent dikes around homes, critical infrastructure and local road access to protect them from flooding.

canada.title: New N.B. study points to education disparities between First Nations, nearby communities
canada.summary: There are big gaps in educational outcomes between First Nations in New Brunswick and their neighbouring communities. And First Nations are calling for more reliable federal education funding to help them change that.

canada.title: N.B. inclusion model 'flawed,' education consultant argues
canada.summary: An education consultant contends New Brunswick's inclusive education policy is contributing to poor test scores and that to suggest otherwise is "denialism."

canada.title: Corner Brook Status of Women Council fills gaps for community ‘in any capacity they need’
canada.summary: On any given day at Corner Brook Status of Women Council, the phone is likely ringing off the hook. On the line is often someone in one of their most vulnerable moments.

canada.title: Shelter workers raise alarm as severe stomach bug hits Montreal's homeless population
canada.summary: A severe stomach bug has spread through Montreal's homeless population, raising concern among shelter workers who say not enough is being done to contain it.

canada.title: I studied silence in Ukraine, but moving to Montreal made me truly understand it
canada.summary: When Anna Lyhina moved from Ukraine to Quebec, she realized immigration can produce its own form of silence — not because anyone forbade her to speak. Learning a new language was about becoming herself again.
